providerDefault: derived from the input image's alpha channel when omitted
summary: Per-pixel strength map for the edit. Black means no edit, white means maximum edit, greys interpolate.
combines: If both an explicit mask and an image with an alpha channel are supplied, the mask wins.
With alpha-derived masks, transparent pixels are edited and opaque pixels are preserved.
